goal: Advance the previously validated 3.447s stock+perturbed horizontal COM decision without shrinking its domain or weakening uncertainty. A shorter 2.463s mass/two-motion fit failed its fully refitted normal guard; retain that independent failure.
method: For every listed candidate carry endpoint use only past centres of the established R16 measurement-conditioned moment model (4 observed pregrasp signatures, 3 COM columns, 1 stiffness, 6 DC and 6 drift nuisance). Selection uses only 24 old unshifted source normals. Use the same 5-block deletion, 0.75mm additive margin, 2.5mm maximum radius, 15mm cap, normal mass/signature domain and substantial/tiny scoring as R16.
selection: For each horizon evaluate fully refitted leave-one-normal-out errors plus all held-out normal 5-block deletions. Require the largest total normal uncertainty <=2.5mm and zero spurious actions on all 24 normal predictions. Choose the earliest such grid point whose next grid point also meets these two conditions. The latest 3424ms endpoint is the existing R16 anchor, not a new improvement. No outcome-dependent shrinkage of the physical margin.
checks: At last endpoint recover R16 calibration guard and coefficients to 1e-10 absolute on the same records. Verify early features use no rows later than chosen centre+23ms, including equality to cached normals and corruption/truncation of future public inputs. Reject rank-deficient moment geometry.
stages: After training horizon is frozen, require exposed four previous R16 groups each both domains to pass all R16 sensing gates before opening any new data. Only then open the three already frozen untouched ep1/ep2/ep3 cohorts from r17_early_interpolation/plan.json, each stock and perturb, five variants. Seal all predictions before truth scoring. This is a sensing result, not a handoff or collision qualification.
control_stop: If both fresh domains pass, assess a separately frozen integrated bounded control on previously known normal bottlenecks; no impacts before protected controls pass, no R10/R16 changes. Never combine solver evidence with different candidate or call a simulation a demo recording.
